objective: Maintain one source of truth for how Chris Izworski tools own search intent, connect into visitor journeys, avoid cannibalization, and qualify future builds.

rules.catalogCoverage: Every first-party tool card on /tools/ must have a registry node.
rules.relationshipTruth: Every relationship is directed, intentional, and points to an existing registry node.
rules.searchOwnership: One canonical owner per primary search intent; supporting pages may reinforce but not compete with that owner.
rules.measurement: Cross-tool behavior uses symbolic source/destination/surface identifiers, never precise location or personal identifiers.
rules.newBuildRule: Score new tool ideas before implementation. Prefer ideas that fill a missing visitor decision and connect to at least two existing nodes.
rules.searchChangePolicy: No search experiment or freeze is active. Search-facing changes follow current evidence, canonical ownership, factual integrity, and cannibalization safety.

cannibalizationGroups.rule: The field map owns operational access/float intent; the guide owns explanatory planning intent.
Report owns current statewide conditions; map owns mapped access; daily owns rotating narrative.
Planning page owns statewide trail-comparison intent; live subdomain owns current snow conditions.
Regional generated pages support local-water intent and must not replace the statewide owner.
Regional and weekend pages resolve distinct local/time intents and feed the flagship rather than duplicate statewide map intent.
Ship Tracker owns lake-wide live tracking; Detroit Freighters owns the narrower Detroit viewing decision; Soo owns location-specific lock intent; Gazette owns news.
Calendar owns full-season planning; supports own distinct frost, tomato, and technique questions.
National Aurora owns U.S. location intent; Northern Lights Michigan remains the deeper canonical for Michigan-specific aurora intent.
National Frost owns non-Michigan U.S. location intent; Michigan Frost Dates remains the Michigan-specific canonical.
National Planting owns broad U.S. location intent; the established Michigan calendar remains canonical for Michigan-specific planting intent.
The national beta owns historical U.S. timing context; Michigan Fall Color retains current Michigan map/peak intent.
National Rivers owns generic nearby gauge conditions; Michigan field maps own river-specific access, route and planning intent.
National Coastal owns broad U.S. location-based beach/coastal conditions. Michigan Beach Report retains the deeper Michigan beach canonical, and Great Lakes Buoys retains station-observation intent.

cannibalizationGroups.intent: National snowpack, snow depth, SWE and snowmelt conditions
cannibalizationGroups.rule: National Snow owns measured pack plus transparent weather-driven melt/refreeze context. Michigan XC keeps trail, grooming and ski-planning intent; Rivers keeps measured flow and official river forecasts. Do not create national groomed-trail, avalanche, road-access or runoff-response claims from Snow.

cannibalizationGroups.intent: White Christmas forecast, odds, climatology and map
cannibalizationGroups.rule: The live national tool owns current-year place-specific White Christmas probability/forecast intent. The map page owns historical national-map intent. Michigan owns state-specific climatology depth. Snowpack remains the measured snowpack canonical. Do not create city/state variants without distinct data depth and search evidence.
Garden Water owns whether/how-much-to-water intent; National Planting remains the owner of crop timing and succession intent.

cannibalizationGroups.intent: Detroit outdoor things to do today
cannibalizationGroups.rule: Detroit Outdoors owns the broad multi-activity today decision. Child surfaces may rank only for their narrower ship-watching, birding, Lake St. Clair water-window, or sunset questions and should feed the hub rather than imitate its broad intent.

cannibalizationGroups.intent: Michigan bird sightings and local birding trip timing
cannibalizationGroups.rule: Michigan Birding Report owns statewide sightings and hotspot evidence. Detroit Birding Today owns a Detroit-specific weather-and-migration trip-timing decision and must not imply a sighting from weather alone.

cannibalizationGroups.intent: Great Lakes observations and Lake St. Clair trip conditions
cannibalizationGroups.rule: Great Lakes Buoys owns station observations across the lakes. Lake St. Clair Outdoors may own the narrower local trip-window decision produced from those observations plus conservative marine and weather gates.

cannibalizationGroups.intent: Michigan snowfall totals by storm and day
cannibalizationGroups.rule: Snow Totals owns reported snowfall (how much fell, where, when) from NWS Local Storm Reports. National Snow owns measured snowpack depth and SWE on the ground. Snowmobile and XC own trail rideability and skiability. Do not create county or city snowfall doorway pages.

cannibalizationGroups.intent: Michigan rockhounding conditions and where to hunt stones
cannibalizationGroups.rule: Rockhounding owns the after-storm hunt decision and collecting rules per beach. Buoys own raw station observations; the Beach Report owns swim notices and hazards. Do not create per-stone or per-beach doorway pages without distinct data.
